assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: final transparent PNG enemy sprite for a flat pixel-cartoon game.
Input image 1 is the CANONICAL style anchor: our original black-haired office hero and purple animated cabinet. The enemy MUST look drawn by the same artist with the same extreme simplicity. Input image 2 is supporting reference for flat chunky cartoon linework and subdued colors only; do not copy its characters, UI, text, composition or background.
Create a SINGLE original enemy described below. Redesign it in the simple flat visual language of the hero and purple cabinet, with a VERY THICK almost-black, clean stepped pixel outline around the entire silhouette and major features, about 5 percent of head width. Awkward humorous silhouette, expressive readable face, big simple parts. Coarse chunky pixels as though drawn on a roughly 96x96 sprite grid; flat filled polygonal clusters. Just 2 or 3 large SOLID color patches per material, a tiny restrained palette. Broad gray, olive, or mauve surfaces and one colored accent. Entire material areas must be flat solid colors.
Composition: square canvas, exactly one full character centered, front/three-quarter view turned toward the LEFT, clear silhouette, 12 percent padding all sides, all extremities visible. Actually transparent PNG with alpha=0 around character and between limbs, no drawn checkerboard, no floor or shadow.
Absolutely no grain, microtexture, speckles, stippling, dithering, tiny clusters, scratches, painterly shading, realistic material, gradient, lighting bloom, glow, 3D rendering, fantasy concept art, realistic animal anatomy, glossy rendering, ornate detail, background, text, letters, UI, frame, extra figures, sprite sheet or multiple views. Simplicity and bold silhouette matter more than detail.
